title: Ad-hoc surge owner rolodex - quick sheet
content:
Purpose: compact, portable spreadsheet for ad-hoc surge coverage and one-off cross-functional owner lookups. Use this when we need a fast owner for a route, region, or customer-impacting incident that isn't in the formal rota. Not a replacement for PagerDuty but a short-hand for immediate outreach and temporary handoffs.

How to use: pick the column that matches the symptom (latency, capacity, billing, security, customer support). Ping the Primary Slack, then Backup if no response in 15m. If it's a platform outage escalate to SRE lead and open a PagerDuty incident. Add any temporary owners below and timestamp.

Quick triage keys: L = latency / T = throughput / C = config / B = billing / S = security / UX = customer-facing UI flows

Sheet table (CSV-style; commas denote columns):
Owner,Role,Team,Primary Slack,Backup Slack,PagerDuty,Typical impact (approx),Common routes/areas,Escalation step,Notes/handback
Maya Chen,Lead - Platform Ops,eng-platform-engineering,#platform-ops,@arjun-p,#infra-ops,~10-50% token throughput drop,hosted-api / routing / cache,Bump to SRE on-call after 20m,Can pause low-priority batching suggestions; knows routing policy config
Arjun Patel,Principal SRE,site-reliability-engineering,#sre-oncall,@sofia-m,#sre-pd,complete regional outage or DB latency,regional routing / KV-cache,SRE on-call -> Eng on-call,Has run emergency rollback of model variants; carries keys for provider failover
Lucas Rivera,Solutions Eng (EMEA),solutions-engineering-and-professional-services,#se-contacts,@ravi-i,,customer-impact escalations (EMEA),dedicated / private deployments,Contact SE lead -> Account Exec,Can coordinate customer-safe rollbacks and data export

Ad-hoc temporary handoffs (fill when you take ownership):
Timestamp,Temp owner,Reason,Expected duration,Notes
2029-11-14 08:20,Lucas Rivera,Customer B reported degraded throughput,4h,Coordinating with Dedicated pool to increase burst cap
2029-11-14 09:05,Maya Chen,Region us-west cache miss storm,2h,Applied emergency KV-cache eviction rules and increased prefix caching

Checklist before handing back to permanent owner:
- Record all changes and PRs opened
- Capture logs and time window for incident
- Revert any temporary toggles unless validated
- Add post-mortem stub to Linear and assign owners

Recent changes log (short):

- 2029-11-13: Clarified escalation step for SRE (20m auto-escalate)

Open questions / follow-ups for ops sync:
- Should platform-ops be given permission to temporarily increase Dedicated burst caps for high-severity incidents? (Assigned: Maya)
- Can CS create a templated rapid-credit flow for recognized billing spikes? (Assigned: Hannah)

Provenance / related docs: see linked artifacts at top. This sheet is intentionally lightweight and designed to be copied into incident channel as a reference table during short-lived surges. Keep changes minimal and record edits in the Recent changes log.
